text: Questions have been raised regarding existing leaseholders and development at Exhibition Place, and how the City's policies and the Board of Governors can contribute to creating good quality work for Toronto residents. I am requesting that the Chief Executive Officer review this issue and report back with options to ensure that high quality jobs with full-time hours, fair wages, and benefits are being created at Exhibition Place.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Directed the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place to review and report back on options for the Board to ensure that high quality jobs with full-time hours, fair wages, and benefits, are being secured through future development of the land and other projects at Exhibition Place, including review of relevant City of Toronto policy such as the Fair Wage Policy.
